newsitem.title: USA: Ashland, Marathon eye downstream deal-report.
newsitem.headline: Ashland, Marathon eye downstream deal-report.

text.p: Ashland Inc and USX-Marathon Group are close to signing a deal which would combine the companies' refining and marketing operations, the Petroleum Intelligence Weekly said in its March 31 edition.

The deal would give Marathon a controlling stake in Ashland's three refineries, totalling 355,000 barrels per day of capacity, and would give the combined company over 600,000 barrels per day of crude oil distillation capacity in the midwestern United States, the report said.
The combined refining capacity of the two companies accounts for about six percent of total U.S. crude oil distillation capacity, the report said.
Neither company was immediately available to comment.
